, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that BERT Base has 10 encoder layers based on unreliable SERP snippets (e.g., GeeksForGeeks/blog) without verifying authoritative sources. BERT Base actually has 12 encoder layers, so the computed difference (10 − 6 = 4) was wrong; it should be 12 − 6 = 6.
